_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform. The ✳️any subset registers `lopdf` under `pdf-1-7-mutate` for the DOCUMENT vocabulary; this file registers the same package under a distinct id and the `pdf-1-7-h-mutate` capability the CONFORMANCE-CLASS case (`mutate-pdf-1-7-h`) tags, because reusing a neighbour's entry fails the contract with `oracle-capability-mismatch`.

oracles.rationale:
🫥️ RECLASSIFIED by the `reimplementation-registered-as-third-party` gate. The crate named here does real work — it parses and writes this format — but what a MUTATION SHOULD PRODUCE is computed by this owner's own `🦀️oracle.rs`. Both halves of the comparison then descend from ONE reading of the specification, so a misreading of it yields two agreeing wrong answers: the single failure a differential test exists to prevent.

The honest split is that the crate discharges "the result is a well-formed file of this format" and NOT "the mutation computed the right answer". Only the second is what a mutation oracle is for, so this is a `cross-semio-implementation` — a required SUPPLEMENT, never a substitute, and a qualifying third-party reference is still owed.

Any fixtures registered alongside are untouched and remain valuable: real bytes of the real format, byte-reproducible, and exactly what a qualifying reader gets pointed at the day one is registered.

📖️ A READER, over a corpus that had to be REBUILT before one could mean anything.

The previous generator imported `oracle_apply_mutation` and `project_conformance` from `semio-s-plugin-stdio-test-oracle`, this repository's own crate, so the mutated bytes AND the expected projection of them were both ours and `lopdf` was a codec for our own answer. Registering a reader beside that corpus would have changed the label and nothing else.

`🦀️lopdf-engine` depends on `lopdf` and nothing else: it lays out the seed, performs each mutation through lopdf's own public COS API, and reads the conformance axes back through it. It refuses to write a pair whose projection does not move, so a no-op cannot be committed as a fixture that would pass forever.

The two encryption kinds are `-uncarried`, not routed around: lopdf 0.44's writer takes its encryption path whenever the trailer carries `/Encrypt` and then needs the encryption state a genuine decryption would have recorded, so a synthetic encryption dictionary can be neither written nor read back. A writer-side limit, not a reader gap.

comparisonProfiles.description: A PDF document compared by the CONFORMANCE-CLASS surface check_h_conformance actually reads, every field read back out of the bytes by the independent `lopdf` object-graph reader: the page count as a stability anchor, plus the document's Info.Title, null when absent; the document's Info.Author, null when absent; every /S /JavaScript action, by the script its /JS carries; every /S /Launch action, by the target its /F carries; every /AcroForm field with /FT /Sig, by its /T title; every /Type /FontDescriptor in object-number order, by which of /FontFile, /FontFile2 or /FontFile3 carries its embedded program, how many bytes that program is once its stream filters are DECODED, and a digest of those decoded bytes. Page CONTENT is deliberately absent — media boxes, content streams and shown text belong to the ✳️any subset's own semantic-pdf-v1 profile, and a conformance class says nothing about them. Object NUMBERS are deliberately absent too: a class is defined on what the document contains, not on where a writer put it, so re-inserting a removed construct at a fresh number is a faithful undo and recording the number would report a false divergence for it. An embedded font program is measured DECODED and never by the length of the stream that stores it: /FontFile, /FontFile2 and /FontFile3 streams are almost always /FlateDecode, and deflate output length is ENCODER FREEDOM — two conformant writers may compress a byte-identical program to byte counts that differ by a byte or two, which is precisely what the first full differential run of these six classes measured (all 23 embedded programs of the real thesis decoded byte-identically while five of their stored streams differed by 1–2 bytes). The ✳️any subset's semantic-pdf-v1 profile already takes that reading, listing streamLength as writer freedom. Decoding is not a relaxation: the decoded length plus a digest of the decoded bytes is a STRICTER axis than the stored length ever was, because a program whose bytes change is now caught even when its length does not. The only numeric fields are the encryption /V and /R, an embedded font program's decoded byte length and the page-box coordinates, all of them exact integers or literal coordinates a writer must reproduce exactly; hence no tolerance.

qualification.evidence: Validated BOTH ways for all 10 witnessable kinds, per-fixture: (base,base) -> equal:true for 10/10; (base,mutated) -> equal:false for 10/10 — 20/20 directions correct. Observability is also enforced at GENERATION time: the engine refuses to write a pair whose projection does not move. The two encryption kinds were caught by exactly that check failing to read its own output (`object ID 8 0 not found`) and are registered -uncarried.

criteria.detail: 10/10 kinds: the kind's own (base,mutated) compares equal:false
The reader projects and compares; it neither applies a mutation nor computes an expected state
The corpus regenerates byte-identically; no wall-clock and no randomness in the seed
lopdf 0.44.0 is vendored in the cargo registry cache; builds and runs with --offline

stages.description: An independent reader accepts both files.
Equality over the h conformance axes — the operative equality.

fixtureManifests.notes: A minimal two-descriptor seed built with lopdf 0.44, with the set-info-title mutation applied THROUGH lopdf's own public COS API (🦀️lopdf-engine/src/lib.rs::apply) — never through this repository's own mutation engine, which is what made the previous corpus inadmissible as evidence. base.pdf is the seed after 🦀️lopdf-engine's arrange put the mutation's precondition in place (identical to the untouched seed for every kind whose precondition is already satisfied); mutated.pdf is the result lopdf wrote. Observability (mutated projection != base projection, both read back through lopdf) is checked for every pair before it is written, and a pair that does not move is refused rather than committed.
